item.title: ULA Vulcan Failure Destroys 40 Amazon Leo Satellites
item.description: ULA's inaugural Vulcan launch suffered a 10‑minute anomaly, destroying 40 Amazon Leo satellites and jeopardizing tight FCC deployment deadlines.
